paragraphs.text: The Dawnchaser Pilgrims are a religious group of people on Muraganda . Their solar effigies mark the beginning of non-animistic, monotheistic religion on the plane.

This order of gold-clad nomads carries their altars with them on large, wheeled carts. They walk across Muraganda following the ancient roads, turning from shadow to seek truth in the dawn hours when night turns to morning. The Dawnchaser Pilgrims keep two magical sites on opposite sides of Muraganda — the Summer City and the Winter City — where they stop to refill their dawnlamps, hone their sundial weapons, and commune with the steady dawn. Twice a year at the proper time, they gather in these cities and hold week-long celebrations to venerate the sun. They are known to follow the construct Sundial .
